segments.text: THys is my commaundement, that ye loue together, as I haue loued you: Greater loue hath no man, then this: that a man beſtowe his lyfe for his frendes. Ye are my frendes, yf ye doe whatſoeuer I commaunde you. Hencefurth call I you not ſeruauntes, for the ſeruaunte knoweth not what his Lorde doeth. But you haue I called frendes: for all thinges that I haue heard of my father, haue I opened to you: ye haue not choſen me, but I haue choſen you, and ordayned you to goe and bryng furth fruite, and that your fruite ſhoulde remayne: that whatſoeuer ye aſke of the father in my name, he maye geue it you.
